summaries.summary: This slide presents BASF Group's H1 2011 financial results compared to H1 2010, highlighting significant growth in sales and earnings, particularly in the chemicals business. Key metrics include €37.8 billion in sales (+19% YoY), €6.4 billion EBITDA (+16%), and a notable +75% increase in net income to €3.9 billion. The slide also notes strong performance from the acquired Cognis business and price-driven growth in Oil & Gas, which contributed to a 34% rise in net income.
key_facts: BASF Group H1 2011 net income: €3.9 billion
